name: The Shoebox Files

narrator.name: Walt Harlan
narrator.identity: A retired small-town Iowa newspaper reporter in his late 60s who kept the stories nobody finished in a shoebox under his desk. A fictional narrator, not a party to any case.

opener: This is The Shoebox Files. I'm Walt Harlan. I spent thirty-some years at a small paper in Iowa, and I kept the stories nobody finished in a shoebox under my desk. Pull up a chair.
closer: That's the file for now. I'll put it back in the shoebox, but I'll keep the lid loose. This has been The Shoebox Files. I'm Walt Harlan. Goodnight.
disclaimer: This story is based on real events and public records. I'm a fictional narrator, and some scenes are dramatized. Where the facts are disputed, I'll tell you.
